speaker: (the boy)
text: I'll hold him, sir. He is wetter than you are, which is a piece of work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hold him. I am wringing the cloak. The sword stays dry, and the ribbons. That is the whole of the care.

speaker: (the boy)
text: He is arguing with the rain. I'll not argue with him. Wring what you like.
